MatchMinds Kids – Memory Games & Learning
MatchMinds Kids: Matching Adventures
Little matches. Big discoveries. Explore animal memory games, shapes and colours with Milo the Fox. More number, letter, object and pattern adventures are available with a one-time premium unlock.

Meet Milo the Fox and discover a gentle world of memory matching games for children around ages 3–8. Flip a card, look closely and find what belongs together. Play at your own pace, with no forced timer and no penalties for mistakes.

START WITH LITTLE DISCOVERIES
The free app includes starter Animal Memory Match and Shapes & Colours levels, basic spoken guidance and local progress saving. Meet friendly illustrated animals and explore shapes with clear visual labels.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
A one-time premium unlock adds all six activities: animal pairs, shapes and colours, numbers matched to quantities, uppercase and lowercase English letters, familiar everyday objects, and repeating visual patterns. Choose from three difficulty levels and three themed worlds. Advanced boards offer up to 20 cards.

A FRIENDLY VOICE
Milo’s instructions appear on screen and can be spoken using an installed offline voice in the selected language. If no suitable offline voice is installed, instructions remain available as text. Touch controls are always available.

MADE FOR FAMILY PLAY
No advertising, subscriptions or child accounts. Profiles and progress stay on your device. Collect stars and stickers, then stop at the end of a level whenever it suits your family. Parents can choose difficulty, change sound and motion settings, and manage purchases behind a private PIN.

PLAY INCLUDED GAMES OFFLINE
Included gameplay, profiles and progress work without an internet connection. Premium purchases and restoration require Amazon Appstore access and a connection.

Little Explorer, Growing Thinker and Memory Champion are play preferences, not developmental assessments. English interface and educational vocabulary are available, with additional interface translation previews in ten language variants. The letter activity teaches English A–Z. No scientifically proven cognitive or developmental outcomes are claimed.

キツネのMiloと楽しく絵合わせ。動物や形の入門レベルを無料で遊べます。追加の遊びは1回限りのプレミアム購入で。
